tasks.description: In docs/userguide/tasks.rst, the 'Task Request' section lists request attributes including ':timelimit: A tuple of the current (soft, hard) time limits'. Add documentation for the new first-class request attributes `time_limit` and `soft_time_limit` (accessible as `task.request.time_limit` / `task.request.soft_time_limit`), noting they are None when no limits are configured, reflect values passed to apply_async, and reflect limits declared at the task class level or via task_time_limit/task_soft_time_limit settings.

In docs/userguide/calling.rst, document that time_limit/soft_time_limit passed to apply_async are now exposed inside the task via task.request.time_limit and task.request.soft_time_limit, and that these override limits declared at the task class level.

Add prose (e.g., in the execution options section) covering the new request attributes and override behavior.
